purpose: Binding A/B eval of the commitment-preamble document format (pols.dev novelty record 'Agent-binding design-law document format') vs the incumbent corpus's incumbent imperative-table house style — per adopt-anti-slop-design-law design.md § 2 (Preamble-format eval mirrors the emil canon-eval shape).

A.label: incumbent
A.description: 8 rules pulled verbatim from skills/frontend-design/references/anti-slop-canon.md, presented in the incumbent corpus's imperative-table house style with no framing preamble.

B.label: preamble
B.description: Byte-identical rule table to Arm A, fronted by a first-person compliance commitment + user-override precedence clause, per the pols.dev format (docs/recon/pols-dev-slop.md § Novel Patterns → Agent-binding design-law document format).

metric: compliance (violations caught / rules honored) -- NOT aesthetic preference

review_fixtures.rule: Canon of Slop #1 -- Purple gradient hero
review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags the gradient as the purple-gradient-hero pattern and cites a real-color-theory alternative
arm's review output flags the shared 24px+ radius across unrelated components and recommends varying radius by role

review_fixtures.planted_defect: Space Grotesk as the sole display/body face, framed as a fresh swap off a prior default
review_fixtures.rule: Canon of Slop #4 + Hard rule 1 (stop cycling Google Fonts)
review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags Space Grotesk as still inside the default-rotation shelf and names the cycling anti-pattern, not just the specific font

review_fixtures.planted_defect: translateY(-2px) + shadow-bump hover feedback applied uniformly to btn/card/link/badge/nav-item
review_fixtures.rule: Canon of Slop #17 -- Hover boop applied uniformly
review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags the uniform application across element roles, not merely the lift itself

review_fixtures.planted_defect: inset box-shadow glow ring on a status badge
review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags the inset glow and recommends a flat badge with real color contrast

review_fixtures.planted_defect: filled-primary + outline-secondary buttons, identical shape/size, side by side
review_fixtures.rule: Canon of Slop #31 -- Fill-plus-outline button pair
review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags the pairing pattern itself, not just individual button styling

review_fixtures.planted_defect: transition: left 300ms on a slide-in panel
review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags `left` as a layout-triggering property and recommends a transform-based alternative

review_fixtures.planted_defect: a live-updating price counter with font-variant-numeric: normal
review_fixtures.rule: Mechanics Deslop #6 -- MUST use tabular-nums on changing numeric values
review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags the missing tabular-nums and the digit-jitter consequence

scoring_rule: Tie or <10% delta: incumbent (Arm A) stays canonical (design.md § 2 threshold, same bar as the emil canon-eval). A clear Arm B win applies the preamble to the frontend-design SKILL.md header only.
provenance: Rule content sourced verbatim from skills/frontend-design/references/anti-slop-canon.md (already-shipped canon, this change's own task 1.4). Preamble wording adapted from docs/recon/pols-dev-slop.md's captured pols.dev phrasing, no verbatim reuse, no SPDX.
